request.style: English, male voice, soulful, solo with background choir, piano, electric guitar, bass, drums, organ, melancholic, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Through fear of death they lived in chains
Held in slavery their whole days
But He set free the ones who grieve
And lifted up the weight of belief

[Pre-Chorus]
He does not help the angels here
But seeks the blood of Abraham clear
Like His brothers in every way
To show us mercy every day

[Chorus]
He is a merciful and faithful priest
In the service of God we need
Making atonement for our sins
With love that breaks the heavy chains

[Verse]
He himself suffered when tempted
He knows the pain, He knows the test
So He is able to help us
When we are falling, He will lift us

[Chorus]
He is a merciful and faithful priest
In the service of God we need
Making atonement for our sins
With love that breaks the heavy chains

[Bridge]
Like His brothers in every respect
He walks the path of human test
Faithful high priest for the people
Healing the wounds that we feel

[Chorus]
He is a merciful and faithful priest
In the service of God we need
Making atonement for our sins
With love that breaks the heavy chains

[Outro]
He is able to help those being tempted
He is able to help those being tempted
